description: Unique sequential row identifier for this table.
Source subset: lit55 / lit119 (curated literature, Ryu et al. 2024), lit503 (large literature DB), slab (in-situ slab experiments), cube (400 mm cube experiment).
Unique concrete mixture identifier within the source.
Mixture family grouping used for leakage-free (grouped) cross-validation.
Original literature or experimental report the record was taken from.
Temperature history used to compute maturity: ambient / standard (20 C bath) / core (embedded sensor) / air.
Specimen curing condition where reported: SC (standard-cured) / AD (air-dry/ambient) / Cored / water / air / core_indoor / core_outdoor. Blank when not applicable (isothermal literature).
Nominal (isothermal literature) or mean (experiments) curing temperature.
Water-to-cement ratio (mass). For the cube mixes this is the effective W/C used in the analysis.
Portland cement content. Blank for slab/cube (proprietary mix not disclosed).
Fly-ash content (0 for plain OPC mixes). Blank where mix design undisclosed.
Other supplementary cementitious material (slag / GGBFS or generic SCM). Blank where undisclosed.
Total binder = cement + fly_ash + SCM_other. Blank where undisclosed.
Fine-aggregate ratio (sand / total aggregate) where reported.
Relative humidity of the curing environment where reported.
Specimen age at test.
Specimen age at test in hours (= age_day x 24).
Nurse-Saul maturity, M = sum (T - T0) dt, datum T0 = -10 C (ASTM C1074).
Arrhenius equivalent age at T_ref = 20 C (293.15 K), Ea = 38300 J/mol default; t_eq = sum exp[-Ea/R (1/T - 1/T_ref)] dt.
Degree-day maturity, DD = sum T dt / 24.
Measured compressive strength. TARGET variable for the strength-prediction models.
Specified/design compressive strength f'c where defined (experiments only).
Peak core temperature reached (cube/slab core records only).
Age at which the peak core temperature occurred.
TRUE where the maturity index was reverse-engineered from a reported maturity/degree-day column rather than integrated from a full temperature history.
Source subset the mixture belongs to.
Concrete mixture identifier (matches S1.mix_id).
Source reference of the mixture (matches S1.ref; see SI_sources.csv).
Fitted ultimate strength, ASTM C1074 hyperbolic S = Su k M / (1 + k M) on equivalent age.
Fitted hyperbolic rate constant k.
Coefficient of determination of the per-mix hyperbolic fit.
Root-mean-square error of the per-mix hyperbolic fit.
Number of strength-age points used in the fit.
Concrete mixture identifier (matches S1.mix_id).
Number of distinct curing temperatures available for the ASTM C1074 Arrhenius calibration (0 = insufficient, default Ea used).
Per-mix apparent activation energy from the Arrhenius plot of rate constant vs 1/T. Blank when not calibratable.
R2 of the Arrhenius (ln k vs 1/T) regression. Blank when not calibratable.

Member whose core history is integrated: slab_Exp1 / slab_Exp2 (field slabs), cube (400 mm cube, mean of the three indoor members' thermocouples), cube_out (the field-exposed fourth member, its own thermocouple).
Water-to-cement ratio (effective) of the member.
Age at which maturities are compared.
Nurse-Saul maturity from the embedded core temperature history.
Arrhenius equivalent age from the core temperature history.
Degree-day maturity from the core temperature history.
Nurse-Saul maturity from the ambient temperature history.
Arrhenius equivalent age from the ambient temperature history.
Degree-day maturity from the ambient temperature history.
Ratio of core to ambient equivalent age (condition-dependent ambient->core transfer factor).
Mean core temperature over the first 72 h (T_early).
Mean ambient temperature over the first 72 h (T_early).
Equivalent age of the air-dry (AD) control specimen where logged.
Equivalent age of the standard-cured (SC) control specimen where logged.
Sequential provenance identifier (SRCnn).
Literature (compiled published data) or My experiment (author's slab/cube tests).
Which S1 subset the source feeds (lit55/lit119/lit503/slab/cube).
Normalised source reference (matches S1.ref).
Number of S1 strength records contributed by this source.
Number of distinct mixtures contributed by this source.
Role of the source in the analysis (model training/CV vs field validation).
Original raw file(s) in the parent project directory the data were parsed from.
